text: You fell into an easy friendship with {new}. Somehow you kept ending up in the same places.
A friendship quietly faded. You and {fade} just stopped making time for each other.
{friend} turned up with news and a bad idea. You laughed more than you had in months.
You made more room for {hobby}, and it made more room in you.
A hard stretch: too many worries and too little sleep. You came through it, a little thinner.
Something small went right, then something else did, and for a while life felt easy.
An unexpected expense landed at the worst moment. It cost @40.
Money turned up when you needed it: a refund, a gift, a favor repaid. #40
You were properly sick for a week and had to slow down.
You picked up something new almost by accident, just from paying attention.
Someone you love had a scare in the hospital. It ended well, but it stayed with you.
{parent} told a story from before you were born. You'll remember it.
You and {sibling} had a falling out, then a clumsy, honest reconciliation.
A season of long walks and quiet evenings. You got to know yourself a little better.
A regret you had carried for years finally loosened its grip.
A chance conversation on a bus turned into a real opportunity. Luck, mostly, but you were there to catch it. #60
Nothing went to plan this year. Missed buses, missed calls, missed chances.
You kept showing up and practicing, and the effort finally started to show.
A long stretch of drifting went by. It felt fine at the time.
